title: Verify: FileStore.FrozenIDs unit tests
summary: Unit tests for FrozenIDs success, not-found and invalid ids
description: Test FrozenIDs against a t.TempDir() root with hand-written snapshot.yaml files.
technical_constraints: Temp dir only, no Git needed

steps.action: Add table-style subtests: (1) write worlds/w/rounds/round-0000001/snapshot.yaml matching the round.Snapshot layout in backend/internal/round/snapshot.go with contribution ids 'a','b' and assert FrozenIDs(ctx,'w','ROUND-0000001') equals []string{'a','b'}; (2) no snapshot file, assert errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound); (3) worldID '../x' and roundID 'a/b' each return non-nil error and not ErrNotFound.
